This being the first public issue of our Company, there has been no formal market for the Equity Shares of our Company. The face value of our
Equity Shares is ₹ 10 each. The Floor Price, Cap Price and the Offer Price (as determined and justified by our Company, in consultation with the

Investments in equity and equity-related securities involve a degree of risk and investors should not invest any funds in the Offer unless they can
